I analyzed the sample windows from BP_Q2_usage_report.pdf and your production traces. Quick findings:

- Average GPU utilization over the 30-day peak window: 72%
- P95 latency correlates strongly with KV cache miss bursts; when miss rate > 12% p95 jumps ~60ms
- Batching currently tuned conservatively (batch size 8); increasing to 12 on non-peak routes reduces cost but increases tail latency for short requests

Recommendation for immediate 90-day plan:
- Provision +4 A100-equivalent GPUs in a dedicated burst pool and enable prefix KV caching on the largest routes (we can do behind-the-scenes tweaks to reduce miss rate). That should lower p95 under 150ms and drop effective utilization to the 60–65% band with the extra capacity.

I attached a quick-sizing sheet with simulation runs for 3/4/6/8 GPUs and estimated p95/cost deltas. Note: the 8-GPU option gives the most headroom for Q4 marketing campaigns if you plan to keep feature set.
